record.summary: The merge predicate as the thesis states it: f(change, attestation_set, policy_version) -> Allow | Deny(reasons), deterministic and side-effect free. This spec founds hqgit-policy: a policy is a WebAssembly module stored as a content-addressed object whose Cid is its version; the engine is wasmtime configured for determinism (no clocks, no randomness, no filesystem, no network, no threads, fuel and memory limits, canonical NaNs); the ABI is one exported function taking the canonical bytes of a PolicyInput and returning the canonical bytes of a Verdict; and the input is built from domain types plus the attestation summaries of a verified set. Same input bytes and same module hash give the same output bytes, which is what makes a verdict replayable years later (067). Writing policies is the SDK's job (066); pinning them to a repository is 068's.
record.title: Policy engine: deterministic WASM merge predicates, hash-pinned
